# qualys_static_search_list (Resource)

A static search list: an explicit set of vulnerability QIDs.

Option profiles reference search lists by ID to define custom vulnerability
detection, so a profile with `vulnerability_detection = "custom"` depends on one
of these.

Membership is managed authoritatively: removing a QID from the configuration
removes it from the list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualys_static_search_list" "critical_web" {
  title  = "critical-web-vulns"
  global = true

  qids = [
    "38170",
    "86476",
    "150003",
  ]
}

resource "qualys_vm_option_profile" "web" {
  title                   = "web-tier-scan"
  vulnerability_detection = "custom"
  custom_search_list_ids  = [qualys_static_search_list.critical_web.id]
}
```

## Deletion ordering

Qualys does not update option profiles when a search list they reference is
deleted, so a profile can be left pointing at a list that no longer exists.
Change the referencing profile first, or let Terraform's dependency ordering do
it by referencing the list's `id` as shown above.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **qids** (Set of String) Qualys vulnerability IDs in this list.
- **title** (String) Name of the search list.

### Optional

- **comments** (String)
- **global** (Boolean) Whether the list is available to all users in the subscription. Defaults to `false`.
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.

### Read-Only

- **created** (String)
- **modified** (String)

## Import

```shell
terraform import qualys_static_search_list.critical_web 123456
```
